recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the old FHIR-15811 wording on DeviceDefinition.version, because that path now has a different canonical-resource meaning; any remaining DeviceDefinition canonical modelling work should be handled under FHIR-42900/FHIR-39389 or their follow-up tickets.
issue_request: FHIR-15811 was Published/Persuasive for STU3. It reported that version information had been treated like device-kind metadata even though software, hardware, and firmware versions vary by instance; the accepted resolution said the then-current Device resource already had version under Device and asked for DeviceDefinition.version to describe available versions of the device, e.g., software versions.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite c1f2872 and 842cb7b, but those commits touch unrelated medicinal product and biologically derived product files. Exact phrase history shows the actual FHIR-15811 application in 703207df98c4873778cec46cf8d80dd2c3ad8433, followed by 7b53206c174560c2d395bae1b33af7aefe58457b to shorten the display text after a build issue. Those commits changed the old DeviceDefinition.version spreadsheet wording to "Available versions" / "The available versions of the device, e.g., software versions."
additional_context: Later related decisions changed the element family. FHIR-25400 converted DeviceDefinition.version from string to a BackboneElement for type/component/value. FHIR-40488 then renamed the device/software version backbone in both Device and DeviceDefinition to deviceVersion. FHIR-42900 and the related FHIR-39389 canonical-resource work added the current canonical business DeviceDefinition.version near the top of the resource.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed because the current build-scope XML has Device.deviceVersion for actual instance versions, DeviceDefinition.deviceVersion for device/software versions available at the definition level, and DeviceDefinition.version for later-approved canonical business versioning.

related_jiras.note: Converted DeviceDefinition device/software version information into a BackboneElement with type/component/value, preserving the seed's kind-level semantics before the later rename.

Added CanonicalResource fields to DeviceDefinition, including the current business DeviceDefinition.version.
